note: The booking agent 'Doddy (books for you)' (decision docs/decisions/2026-11-12-book-agent.md) has no webhook or client tools on purpose: it can only talk. It may say one server-built confirmation line for the one booking the user approved; it cannot pay, send, read memories or transfer. voice_agent_spec.py --agent task-call-book fails if anything else is added; the server's drift check (server/messaging/src/taskCalls/agentSafety.ts) refuses calls if the live agent has anything else.

system_tools.name: end_call
system_tools.description: End the call after saying goodbye: once the booking is confirmed, they can't make it, or anything outside the booking was asked.

system_tools.name: voicemail_detection
system_tools.description: Use when a voicemail greeting or answering machine answers. Leave no message.
